outcome: percentage of highly active mast cells
presence of free mast cell granules
cohort: Cervical biopsies were obtained from women undergoing surgical termination of pregnancy in the first trimester, surgery for first-trimester miscarriage, elective caesarean section, and benign gynaecological surgery in non-pregnant women.
finding: The study found an increased influx and stimulated secretory activity of mast cells in the cervix during pregnancy, particularly at term, suggesting their physiological role in cervical ripening and tissue remodelling.
cross-section timing: Biopsies were obtained during the first trimester (from women undergoing termination or miscarriage) and at term (from women undergoing elective caesarean section), as well as from non-pregnant women.
